query: SELECT timestamp, log_attributes['function_id'] AS function_id, log_attributes['version'] AS version, event_message FROM logs WHERE source='function_logs' AND position(event_message,'wave5_ingress_v3')>0 AND log_attributes['function_id']='f292d0dd-5907-439e-8687-0f7d8789bb42' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 5
